## Project Overview
My research project is about demographic differences in Texas prisons. I hope to answer demographic questions about drug offenses, along with the racial makeup of Texas prisons as a whole. Additionally, this research project hopes to explore if there are any potential impacts of policy on the racial makeup of Texas prisons.
